notes: Reference C++/C ABI sources are collected for 22 public chips. source-only does not claim an independent SDK Native build.

Standalone CMake targets build thirteen static libraries covering seventeen chip IDs: YM2612, YM2203, YM2608, YM2610/YM2610B, YM2151, YM2413, Sega PSG, AY-3-8910, OKIM6258, RF5C164, the shared YM3526/YM3812/YMF262/Y8950 OPL family, Game Boy and HuC6280. YM2612 Nuked sources remain reference-only.
Vendor component origins and license files are recorded by the shared source inventory, rather than copied again here.

chips.verificationScope: Independent pinned DMG APU renderer exposing native_gameboy_*: two pulse channels, wave RAM, noise, stereo routing, power, mute, clock resampling, per-channel gate stop, immediate global Stop, reset and observational state. Offline Worklet/WASM PCM comparison; no machine emulator, audio device, scheduler or playback-deadline guarantee.
